title: Drifting Aurora Bands
description: Soft blurred aurora ribbons drift through one master cycle over 240 frames; each ribbon uses an integer phase harmonic for a mathematically closed loop.

title: Floating Soft Bokeh
description: Defocused color circles orbit and breathe through one master cycle over 240 frames, with integer one-to-three-cycle harmonics that close together.

title: Flowing Topographic Contours
description: Seventeen restrained SVG contour paths flow through one master cycle over 240 frames; secondary ridges complete exactly two cycles.

title: Slow Starfield Parallax
description: Three toroidally wrapped star depths drift through one master cycle over 240 frames; every layer travels an integer wrapped distance and returns exactly.

title: Undulating Wave Layers
description: Four translucent SVG wave fills undulate through one master cycle over 240 frames, using integer one-to-four-cycle temporal harmonics.

title: Rotating Conic Sheen
description: A diffused conic sheen makes one full rotation over 240 frames while its scale completes exactly two breathing cycles.

title: Rising Ambient Bubbles
description: Translucent bubbles rise on wrapped lanes through one master cycle over 240 frames; lane rates complete one, two, or three exact cycles.

title: Breathing Duotone Geometry
description: Minimal duotone shapes rotate and breathe through one master cycle over 240 frames, with every shape completing an integer number of turns.

title: Drifting Cloud Parallax
description: Blurred cloud blobs cross three wrapped depth planes in one master cycle over 240 frames; vertical drift uses integer one-to-three-cycle harmonics.

title: Subtle Diagonal Stripe Flow
description: Fine diagonal stripes shift by exactly one 72-pixel pattern cycle over 240 frames while the low-contrast sheen breathes twice.
